title: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network for sample-efficient recognition of topological phases
summary: With increasing maturity of quantum computers, standard methods for characterizing global properties of their output quantum states via direct measurements and classical post-processing are becoming increasingly impractical due to large measurement costs. Although quantum neural networks could directly process quantum states to identify underlying characteristics with reduced measurement efforts, they often require deep quantum circuits that cannot be implemented on existing devices.
